comments.author: yuri
comments.text: FINAL: tk-szb complete. (1) lib/adapters/sse_bus.ts — host-fed delta transport: monotonic ids, 256-ring, per-connection fan-out, gap-aware replay (missed-beyond-ring/garbage/future/no-id → [] → snapshot-only degrade), formatSse supports unnumbered snapshot frames. (2) domain: HubEventTopic += phase (mirrors docs/02 event frames). (3) web/src/sse.ts — topic→delta vocabulary: log carries precomputed sessionHue, attention op=raised/resolved from resolvedAt, strict payload validation (malformed dropped, never fabricated). (4) routes/table.ts streamResponse: first event fresh snapshot (=GET /api/status shape), Last-Event-ID header or lastEventId query param → ring replay with original ids + fresh snapshot, snapshots unnumbered so replay idempotent, broken consumers pruned, snapshot-read failure closes stream. (5) server.ts: subscribes bus on start, maps hub events via sseEventsFor, stop() unsubscribes + closes all streams gracefully then sweeps.
